Message:
“You poured me a cup of tea?
Thank you, Moineau.”

“Hmm... There’s no need
to prepare my breakfast, though.
I’m not hungry this morning.”

To that, Moineau said,
“I shall prepare
some snacks for you, then.”
She truly is kind.

Oh, right!
It’s about time I fed my bird.
Now, make sure to eat a whole...!

...I must prepare
a grave for it...
I’ll lay out a
bed of flowers inside,
just like always...

What should I do...?
It’s come back...

My illness...
that hurts those around me
in my place...
